scope: Six flat front panels R01, R03, R04, R05, R06, R07, their cutouts and raised marks, and 49 legacy cap placements. Roofs, shell, retainers and jog components are outside this addendum.

companion_files.frontpanel_data.json: Verbatim B26-CONSOLIDATED-01 source-derived dataset: 69 aperture records with panel identity, 28 closure axes, five fader centres, 65 raised P-mark polygons, panel operation summary and roof information. Panel operations below clarify the source order and edge cases; the roof fields are outside this addendum.

panel_construction.initial_stock: Each part occupies Z18..20. Add and subtract rectangles at the extents below before performing any rounds; intersecting cuts are naturally clipped by each individual panel boundary.
operations_in_order: Subtract the 69 through apertures assigned to their panel in frontpanel_data.json, from Z17 through Z22. A circle has diameter W; a rect is W by H; rr is W by H with corner radius R; a slot has overall length max(W,H), width min(W,H), long axis Y when H > W and X otherwise. T IDs override their listed rr metadata: let a=7.2+1.6*sqrt(5), s=+1 for odd numeric T ID and -1 for even; CAD XY vertices are (X+s*u,-Y+s*v) for (u,v)=(-a,0),(4,(a+4)/2),(4,-(a+4)/2).

Round the vertical outside corner edge R3 on R01 at table (0,0), R04 at (600,0), R05 at (0,320), R07 at (600,320). Then fillet R0.8 the Z20 edges on the external 600 by 320 outline including its R3 corner arcs; do not round internal seams or aperture edges at this step.

For each assigned fader centre subtract a rounded rectangle from Z19 through Z22: F01-F04 14 X by 69.7 Y; F05 69.7 X by 14 Y; corner radius 3. Chamfer its Z20 perimeter 0.8. The already-cut central slot extends through the remaining panel; the pocket floor is Z19 and is not the panel underside.

On each of R01 and R05 cut at table (110,165), and on each of R04 and R07 cut at (490,165): radius 26 from Z17 through Z22 and radius 54 from Z19 through Z22. Chamfer the resulting Z20 R54 edge 0.8. The centres lie on the split: cut each panel separately; do not add a full unsplit ring.
Chamfer Z20 edges of B and T apertures 0.8. P, F, L and E aperture edges do not receive this cap-edge operation.

Add the 65 P-mark polygons in frontpanel_data.json at their listed panel, coordinates and Z20..20.4. They are individually placed polygons, not a font or text approximation. For provenance, original P04 polygons are also translated to P01/P02/P03 at X559, Y41/69/97 by the released source. Preserve the transcribed final coordinates; do not translate them a second time.

Add 22 fader tick rectangles per fader, at Z19..19.4, i.e. on the recessed floor. For j=0..10 let u=-travel/2+j*travel/10, travel=28 for F05 and 41 otherwise. For sign=-1,+1 and length=4 when j is 0,5,10, otherwise 2, use local corners (u-0.4,sign*2.4), (u+0.4,sign*2.4), (u+0.4,sign*(2.4+length)), (u-0.4,sign*(2.4+length)). If local coordinates are (uu,vv), table XY is (x+uu,y-vv) for F05, otherwise (x+vv,y+uu). The fader centres (x,y) are in frontpanel_data.json.

Finally subtract the 28 closure holes at their panel-specific centres: cylinder radius 1.7 from Z17 through Z22, followed by a coaxial conical countersink from Z18.7 to Z20, bottom radius 1.7 and top radius 3. Dimensions are nominal; actual fastener fit is unverified.
panel_construction.edge_selection: The released code tests five sampled points on candidate edges for the specified Z20 perimeter predicates with 1e-5 mm tolerance. This is an operation-selection tolerance, not a part tolerance. Corner edges use 1e-6 mm coordinate comparisons. Boolean kernel outcomes and fillet continuity are not independently established by this document.

cap_definition_and_placement.mesh_frame: The triangles' vertices_mm are local mesh Cartesian coordinates in millimetres, with no scaling on import. Preserve each triangle normal, vertex order, and 16-bit attribute. To recover each selected binary STL byte-for-byte, decode its 80-byte header_base64, append triangle_count as unsigned little-endian uint32, then each normal and its three vertices as 12 little-endian IEEE-754 binary32 values followed by the unsigned little-endian uint16 attribute. Source SHA-256 is recorded per definition in the mesh dataset; these are faceted surfaces, not inferred parametric features.
cap_definition_and_placement.frame_application: For each occurrence use its cad_origin_mm as O, cad_x_direction as ex and cad_z_direction as ez. Set ey=ez cross ex as the right-handed build123d Plane convention. A local mesh vertex (u,v,w) maps to global CAD O + u*ex + v*ey + w*ez; apply no further drawing-Y reflection to this CAD result. To express a resulting position in table coordinates, negate its global CAD Y. The source B24 inventory pose translation was in cm and is multiplied by 10; local STL vertices are already mm. The poses dataset already includes B26 X/Y owner deltas: do not apply them again.
cap_definition_and_placement.identity: Each occurrence is distinguished by owner and full inventory_id; mesh_definition is one of nine keys. A shared definition does not make the 49 occurrences interchangeable. These are retained control-cap references; purchased mating geometry and physical fit are TBD.

limitations: No revision-02 drawing, geometry, STEP/STL, physical fit, manufacture or electrical safety is approved by this addendum. Bought-part and electrical interfaces are incomplete schematic references; unspecified geometry, fasteners, mounting fit, materials and tolerances remain TBD by the engineer.

The 01 dataset and this addendum have not been independently reconstructed or compared against the released source Boolean surfaces. Prior 01 count and mesh byte checks are reported in its validation JSON, not new checks. Display roofs and control retainers require their own documentation.

P01 here is a panel control identifier and must not be confused with jog P01 rotor. The released STEP strict default-volume check for each jog P01 rotor failed by 0.641091522 mm3 against 0.0001 mm3; the engineer accepted only a bounded unpowered-trial exception. Adaptive difference 0.000001609 mm3 and zero directed cut volumes do not establish exact surface equivalence. See models/release/enclosure/B26/B26-build123d03_RELEASE/B26-build123d03_handoff.md, STEP exception section.
